scope: Whole original UltraRig-G application port: physical panel adaptation only
address_note: Patch CPU addresses are FLASH LOAD addresses in decoded app area. Copied IRQ/data also list their runtime VMA; raw NOR is encrypted.

patches.name: mini_panel_serial_writer_disabled
patches.rationale: Replace entry by RAM-cache store and normal return; no PA0..3 access. LED driver is pending.

patches.name: mini_panel_input_banks
patches.rationale: First three physical inputs use port A; inaccessible G slots 3/4 are retained in the file.

patches.name: mini_panel_input_bits
patches.rationale: MINI stock scan order PA10, PA0, PA3; active low. Physical label order is unmeasured.

patches.name: mini_panel_init_three
patches.rationale: Limit the same loop to three physical MINI switches; retain branch/register fields.

patches.name: mini_panel_poll_three
patches.rationale: Limit the same loop to three physical MINI switches; retain branch/register fields.

patches.name: mini_panel_irq_three
patches.rationale: Limit the same loop to three physical MINI switches; retain branch/register fields.

patches.name: mini_panel_logical_default
patches.rationale: Logical A/B/C map to physical scan indices 0/1/2; D maps to an inactive, valid state slot 3.

patches.name: mini_panel_restore_fixed_map
patches.rationale: Configuration restore uses its index as mapping value; a persisted G permutation cannot replace MINI wiring.

patches.name: mini_panel_skip_G_analog_init
patches.rationale: Skip G PB1/PC6..8 initialization and initial ADC samples; preserve prior RAM initialization and following epilogue.

patches.name: mini_panel_G_analog_scan_disabled
patches.rationale: Keep state+832 zero: gates panel ADC/mux block and CE8E -> CDE0 initialization path. Knobs/expression pending.

serial_writer.known_MINI_conflict: PA1 codec SDA and PA2 codec SCL; PA0 and PA3 MINI switches

inputs.logical_D: state slot 3, initially released, no physical scanner

G_analog_controls.proof_scope: Decoded selected paths and direct-reference survey; not a full binary alias/indirect-call proof.

callgraph_scope: Selected direct calls and verified local control flow. A linear decoder includes data and cannot prove absence of all computed calls.
